name: The Human Neural Organoid Atlas
description: The HNOCA includes data from 36 neural organoid datasets and includes harmonised cell type annotations, as well as curated biological, and technical metadata. The datasets in the HNCOA were integrated using scPoli. The HNOCA can be used as a reference to map new datasets onto using scArches, allowing the transfer of the harmonized cell-type labels to any new dataset.

labelsets.name: annot_level_2
labelsets.description: Finer curated cell type annotation of the integrated HNOCA.

labels.name: Non-telencephalic NPC
labels.rationale: Cells expressing canonical non-telencephalic npc markers in organoids.  Expression of SOX2 + any of the other genes is sufficient to classify a cell as of this type.
labels.ontologyAssessment: No specific term available for non-telencephalic NPCs. Had to pick the generic npc term.

labels.name: Non-telencephalic Neuron
labels.rationale: Cells expressing canonical non-telencephalic neuron markers in organoids.  Expression of MAP2, MAPT, DCX + any of the other genes is sufficient to classify a cell as of this type.
labels.ontologyAssessment: No specific term available for non-telencephalic neurons, (only more specific ones like mid-/hindbrain). Had to pick the generic neuron term.
